BiblicalUsage: Naboth is the Jezreelite whose vineyard cost him his life and cost Ahab his house. In 1 Kings 21:1 Naboth has a vineyard in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria, and in 1 Kings 21:13 false witnesses say he blasphemed God and the king, and he is stoned. In 2 Kings 9:26 the Lord says He saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons, and will requite it in that same plot of ground.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Naboth's vineyard is the clearest picture in the Bible of what happens when a king wants what is not his. Naboth would not sell his inheritance, and that refusal cost him everything in this life, but God saw the blood and answered for it, and my position is that an inheritance kept is worth more than a king's price.
